info.title: Hanzo Cloud API
info.description: Generated from the live router — every operation below is a route the unified cloud binary actually serves. Tagged by product: the first path segment after /v1/.

get.summary: askByQuery answers a question about the org's code from the URL, with citations.
get.description:
askByQuery answers a question about the org's code from the URL, with citations.

It is the GET form of ask: the question rides `?q=` instead of a body, and the
answer is identical.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Q is the question to answer. Required, max 4000 chars.

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: Repo narrows the retrieval to one indexed repo; empty searches all of them.

post.summary: ask answers a question about the org's code, with citations into the index.
post.description:
ask answers a question about the org's code, with citations into the index.

Retrieval runs over the caller org's index and the answer is synthesised from
what it found, so every claim carries the span it came from.
A synthesis outage answers 200 with degraded true and no citations, never a 5xx.

post.summary: context packs the org's index into a token-budgeted bundle for one question.
post.description:
context packs the org's index into a token-budgeted bundle for one question.

It is THE agent primitive: retrieval, ranking and packing in one call, so an
agent spends its context window on the spans most likely to answer the query.
A retrieval outage answers 200 with an empty bundle rather than a 5xx.

get.summary: file returns the INDEXED content of one file, as the search tiers hold it.
get.description:
file returns the INDEXED content of one file, as the search tiers hold it.

It is a fast "show the code the index knows" for context, and it is NOT
byte-verbatim: the git object plane is the source of record for exact bytes,
history and blame.
A file absent from the index is a 404, so an agent can tell "not indexed" from
an empty file.

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: Repo is the repo the file belongs to. Required.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path is the file's repo-relative path. Required.

post.summary: index (re)indexes a repo for the caller org, skipping files whose content is unchanged.
post.description:
index (re)indexes a repo for the caller org, skipping files whose content is unchanged.

The pass is incremental by content hash, and prune makes it a full-tree
reconcile: files absent from the payload leave the index.

get.summary: search runs one hybrid search over the caller org's code index.
get.description:
search runs one hybrid search over the caller org's code index.

The tier is chosen by type — text, regex, symbol, semantic or hybrid (the
default, which fuses all three with reciprocal-rank fusion).
A retrieval outage answers 200 with an empty result and degraded true, never a
5xx to the agent; only a malformed regex is a 400.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Q is the search query. Required, max 4000 chars.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description:
Type selects the tier: text, regex, symbol, semantic or hybrid (the default,
and what any unknown value falls back to).

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: Repo narrows the search to one indexed repo; empty searches all of them.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Limit caps the spans returned; 0 means 20 and nothing above 100 is honoured.

get.summary: tree returns a repo's indexed file structure with per-file symbol counts.
get.description:
tree returns a repo's indexed file structure with per-file symbol counts.

It is get_repo_structure over the org's OWN indexed corpus — no git checkout.
A repo that has not been indexed returns an empty tree, never an error.

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: Repo is the repo label to inspect. Required.

query.description: Query is the question to answer. Required, max 4000 chars.

repo.description: Repo narrows the retrieval to one indexed repo; empty searches all of them.

budgetTokens.description: BudgetTokens caps the bundle; 0 means 4000, and it is clamped to 256..32000.

query.description: Query is what the bundle is packed to answer. Required, max 4000 chars.

repo.description: Repo narrows the search to one indexed repo; empty searches all of them.

path.description: Path is the file's repo-relative path.

content.description: Content is the indexed text, reassembled from the file's chunks.

lang.description: Lang is the language the parser detected.

path.description: Path echoes the file's repo-relative path.

repo.description: Repo echoes the repo the file belongs to.

chunks.description: Chunks is the repo's total chunk count after the pass.

files.description: Files is the repo's total indexed file count after the pass.

indexed.description: Indexed counts the files this pass wrote.

pruned.description: Pruned counts the indexed files removed because the payload omitted them.

repo.description: Repo echoes the repo that was indexed.

semantic.description: Semantic is whether the embedder was enabled for this pass.

skipped.description: Skipped counts the files whose content hash was unchanged.

symbols.description: Symbols is the repo's total symbol count after the pass.

vectors.description: Vectors is the repo's total embedded-chunk count after the pass.

files.description: Files are the files to index; at most 20000, 1 MiB each, 1 GiB in total.

prune.description:
Prune removes indexed files absent from this payload, making the pass a
full-tree reconcile.

repo.description: Repo is the repo label the files are indexed under. Required.

degraded.description:
Degraded is true when retrieval failed and the empty result is an outage,
not an absence of matches.

query.description: Query echoes the query that was run.

results.description: Results are the matching spans, ranked; empty when nothing matched.

type.description: Type echoes the tier that was run, after defaulting.

files.description:
Files is one entry per indexed file, with its per-file symbol count; empty
for a repo that has not been indexed.

repo.description: Repo echoes the repo the tree is of.
